title: 穿透電子顯微鏡
summary: 以 300 kV 穿透電子顯微鏡為對象：從 1.97 pm 的電子波長與布拉格繞射出發，推導 Scherzer 解析度、對比傳遞函數與色像差資訊極限，理解六極 Cs 校正器為何把解析度推到 0.1 nm 以下，再把高壓與透鏡電流的 ppm 級穩定度、樣品厚度與撞擊損傷、場址環境與驗收測試整合成可交付的工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Taking a 300 kV transmission electron microscope: start from the 1.97 pm electron wavelength and Bragg diffraction, derive Scherzer resolution, the contrast transfer function and the chromatic information limit, see why a hexapole Cs corrector pushes resolution below 0.1 nm, then integrate ppm-level high-voltage and lens-current stability, specimen thickness and knock-on damage, site environment and acceptance tests into a deliverable engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電子波長、散射與對比機制」與「相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" and "Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電子波長、散射與對比機制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」如何決定穿透電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” determines the key performance of “Transmission electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿透電子顯微鏡讓高能電子穿過厚度數十奈米的薄樣品，物鏡把透射與散射電子在後焦面形成繞射圖、在像平面形成影像，後續的中間鏡與投影鏡選擇放大哪一個平面。對比有三種來源：質量厚度對比來自被物鏡光圈擋掉的高角散射；繞射對比來自晶體特定取向滿足布拉格條件；相位對比來自透射束與繞射束在像平面的干涉，是晶格影像的基礎。300 kV 的電子波長只有 1.97 pm，布拉格角只有幾個毫弧度，所以整個光學系統在極小角度內工作，像差成為主要限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick; the objective lens forms a diffraction pattern in its back focal plane and an image in the image plane, and intermediate and projector lenses choose which plane to magnify. Contrast has three origins: mass-thickness contrast from high-angle scattering stopped by the objective aperture; diffraction contrast from crystal orientations satisfying Bragg's condition; and phase contrast from interference of transmitted and diffracted beams in the image plane, the basis of lattice imaging. At 300 kV the electron wavelength is only 1.97 pm and Bragg angles are a few milliradians, so the whole optical system works within tiny angles and aberrations become the dominant limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對論波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：80 kV 4.18 pm、200 kV 2.51 pm、300 kV 1.97 pm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relativistic wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 4.18 pm at 80 kV, 2.51 pm at 200 kV, 1.97 pm at 300 kV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「穿透電子顯微鏡的影像對比和光學顯微鏡一樣來自吸收。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "TEM image contrast comes from absorption, as in a light microscope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電子波長、散射與對比機制
knowledge.titleEn: Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms

knowledge.textEn: A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick; the objective lens forms a diffraction pattern in its back focal plane and an image in the image plane, and intermediate and projector lenses choose which plane to magnify. Contrast has three origins: mass-thickness contrast from high-angle scattering stopped by the objective aperture; diffraction contrast from crystal orientations satisfying Bragg's condition; and phase contrast from interference of transmitted and diffracted beams in the image plane, the basis of lattice imaging.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：穿透電子顯微鏡的影像對比和光學顯微鏡一樣來自吸收。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: TEM image contrast comes from absorption, as in a light microscope. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電子波長、散射與對比機制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" is correct?
options: 穿透電子顯微鏡的影像對比和光學顯微鏡一樣來自吸收。
穿透電子顯微鏡讓高能電子穿過厚度數十奈米的薄樣品，物鏡把透射與散射電子在後焦面形成繞射圖、在像平面形成影像，後續的中間鏡與投影鏡選擇放大哪一個平面。
Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。
optionsEn: TEM image contrast comes from absorption, as in a light microscope.
A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick.
After Cs correction resolution is limited only by electron wavelength and reaches picometres.
quiz.explanation: 穿透電子顯微鏡讓高能電子穿過厚度數十奈米的薄樣品，物鏡把透射與散射電子在後焦面形成繞射圖、在像平面形成影像，後續的中間鏡與投影鏡選擇放大哪一個平面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick; the objective lens forms a diffraction pattern in its back focal plane and an image in the image plane, and intermediate and projector lenses choose which plane to magnify. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電子波長、散射與對比機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對論波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：80 kV 4.18 pm、200 kV 2.51 pm、300 kV 1.97 pm。布拉格角 θ_B ≈ λ/(2d)：矽 (111) d = 0.3136 nm 在 300 kV 為 3.14 mrad = 0.18°；矽 [110] 啞鈴間距 0.136 nm 對應 7.2 mrad。繞射圖中環的半徑 R = L·λ/d：相機長度 L = 0.5 m、金 (111) d = 0.2355 nm 時 R = 4.18 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relativistic wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 4.18 pm at 80 kV, 2.51 pm at 200 kV, 1.97 pm at 300 kV. Bragg angle θ_B ≈ λ/(2d): silicon (111) with d = 0.3136 nm gives 3.14 mrad = 0.18° at 300 kV; the 0.136 nm silicon [110] dumbbell spacing corresponds to 7.2 mrad. Ring radius in the diffraction pattern R = L·λ/d: at camera length L = 0.5 m and gold (111) d = 0.2355 nm, R = 4.18 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多晶金薄膜拍選區繞射圖，量 (111)、(200)、(220) 環半徑，與 R = Lλ/d 計算值比較以校正相機長度；再把矽單晶轉到 [110] 帶軸，確認繞射點的角度分佈與計算的布拉格角一致，並切換物鏡光圈大小觀察質量厚度與繞射對比的消長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record a selected-area diffraction pattern of polycrystalline gold, measure the (111), (200) and (220) ring radii and compare with R = Lλ/d to calibrate camera length; tilt a silicon crystal to the [110] zone axis, confirm the angular distribution of spots matches the computed Bragg angles, and change the objective aperture size to watch mass-thickness and diffraction contrast trade off.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相對論波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：80 kV 4.18 pm、200 kV 2.51 pm、300 kV 1.97 pm。布拉格角 θ_B ≈ λ/(2d)：矽 (111) d = 0.3136 nm 在 300 kV 為 3.14 mrad = 0.18°；矽 [110] 啞鈴間距 0.136 nm 對應 7.2 mrad。繞射圖中環的半徑 R = L·λ/d：相機長度 L = 0.5 m、金 (111) d = 0.2355 nm 時 R = 4.18 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Relativistic wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 4.18 pm at 80 kV, 2.51 pm at 200 kV, 1.97 pm at 300 kV. Bragg angle θ_B ≈ λ/(2d): silicon (111) with d = 0.3136 nm gives 3.14 mrad = 0.18° at 300 kV; the 0.136 nm silicon [110] dumbbell spacing corresponds to 7.2 mrad. Ring radius in the diffraction pattern R = L·λ/d: at camera length L = 0.5 m and gold (111) d = 0.2355 nm, R = 4.18 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子波長、散射與對比機制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms", which statement holds?
options: 極靴間隙越小越好，因為像差係數更低。
加速電壓越高穿透力越強，所以總是對樣品更溫和。
相對論波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：80 kV 4.18 pm、200 kV 2.51 pm、300 kV 1.97 pm。
optionsEn: A smaller pole-piece gap is always better because aberration coefficients are lower.
Higher accelerating voltage penetrates better and is therefore always gentler on the specimen.
Relativistic wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 4.18 pm at 80 kV, 2.51 pm at 200 kV, 1.97 pm at 300 kV.
quiz.explanation: 相對論波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：80 kV 4.18 pm、200 kV 2.51 pm、300 kV 1.97 pm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Relativistic wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 4.18 pm at 80 kV, 2.51 pm at 200 kV, 1.97 pm at 300 kV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子波長、散射與對比機制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以多晶金薄膜拍選區繞射圖，量 (111)、(200)、(220) 環半徑，與 R = Lλ/d 計算值比較以校正相機長度；再把矽單晶轉到 [110] 帶軸，確認繞射點的角度分佈與計算的布拉格角一致，並切換物鏡光圈大小觀察質量厚度與繞射對比的消長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record a selected-area diffraction pattern of polycrystalline gold, measure the (111), (200) and (220) ring radii and compare with R = Lλ/d to calibrate camera length; tilt a silicon crystal to the [110] zone axis, confirm the angular distribution of spots matches the computed Bragg angles, and change the objective aperture size to watch mass-thickness and diffraction contrast trade off. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多晶金薄膜拍選區繞射圖，量 (111)、(200)、(220) 環半徑，與 R = Lλ/d 計算值比較以校正相機長度；再把矽單晶轉到 [110] 帶軸，確認繞射點的角度分佈與計算的布拉格角一致，並切換物鏡光圈大小觀察質量厚度與繞射對比的消長。
knowledge.textEn: Record a selected-area diffraction pattern of polycrystalline gold, measure the (111), (200) and (220) ring radii and compare with R = Lλ/d to calibrate camera length; tilt a silicon crystal to the [110] zone axis, confirm the angular distribution of spots matches the computed Bragg angles, and change the objective aperture size to watch mass-thickness and diffraction contrast trade off.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電子波長、散射與對比機制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms"?
options: 以多晶金薄膜拍選區繞射圖，量 (111)、(200)、(220) 環半徑，與 R = Lλ/d 計算值比較以校正相機長度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
顯微鏡放在地下室就自動滿足振動與磁場規格。
optionsEn: Record a selected-area diffraction pattern of polycrystalline gold, measure the (111), (200) and (220) ring radii and compare with R = Lλ/d to calibrate camera length.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Putting the microscope in a basement automatically satisfies vibration and field specifications.
quiz.explanation: 以多晶金薄膜拍選區繞射圖，量 (111)、(200)、(220) 環半徑，與 R = Lλ/d 計算值比較以校正相機長度；再把矽單晶轉到 [110] 帶軸，確認繞射點的角度分佈與計算的布拉格角一致，並切換物鏡光圈大小觀察質量厚度與繞射對比的消長。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record a selected-area diffraction pattern of polycrystalline gold, measure the (111), (200) and (220) ring radii and compare with R = Lλ/d to calibrate camera length; tilt a silicon crystal to the [110] zone axis, confirm the angular distribution of spots matches the computed Bragg angles, and change the objective aperture size to watch mass-thickness and diffraction contrast trade off. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電子波長、散射與對比機制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：300 kV 的電子波長只有 1.97 pm，布拉格角只有幾個毫弧度，所以整個光學系統在極小角度內工作，像差成為主要限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 300 kV the electron wavelength is only 1.97 pm and Bragg angles are a few milliradians, so the whole optical system works within tiny angles and aberrations become the dominant limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「穿透電子顯微鏡的影像對比和光學顯微鏡一樣來自吸收。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "TEM image contrast comes from absorption, as in a light microscope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。
knowledge.textEn: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電子波長、散射與對比機制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。
Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects.
After Cs correction resolution is limited only by electron wavelength and reaches picometres.
quiz.explanation: 樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」如何決定穿透電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus” determines the key performance of “Transmission electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 薄樣品是弱相位物體，影像對比由對比傳遞函數 CTF(u) = sin χ(u) 決定，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴，u 是空間頻率。球面像差 C_s 讓相位隨 u⁴ 快速振盪，CTF 在第一個過零點之後正負交替，影像不再直觀；Scherzer 離焦把 Δf 選成讓低頻段形成最寬的負值通帶，第一個過零點定義點解析度。六極或八極 Cs 校正器產生負的球面像差抵銷物鏡的正值，使 C_s 可調到接近零甚至微負，過零點外推到色像差資訊極限，解析度由 0.17 nm 進入 0.1 nm 以下，並消除離域效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A thin specimen is a weak phase object whose image contrast follows the contrast transfer function CTF(u) = sin χ(u) with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴ and u the spatial frequency. Spherical aberration C_s makes the phase oscillate rapidly with u⁴, so beyond the first zero the CTF alternates sign and the image stops being intuitive; Scherzer defocus chooses Δf to form the widest negative passband at low frequency, and the first zero defines point resolution. A hexapole or octupole Cs corrector produces negative spherical aberration to cancel the objective's positive value, letting C_s be tuned near zero or slightly negative, pushing the first zero out to the chromatic information limit, taking resolution from 0.17 nm to below 0.1 nm and removing delocalisation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Scherzer 點解析度 d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼，Scherzer 離焦 Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Scherzer point resolution d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼ and Scherzer defocus Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After Cs correction resolution is limited only by electron wavelength and reaches picometres." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Spherical aberration C_s makes the phase oscillate rapidly with u⁴, so beyond the first zero the CTF alternates sign and the image stops being intuitive; Scherzer defocus chooses Δf to form the widest negative passband at low frequency, and the first zero defines point resolution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction" is correct?
options: Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。
只要像差校正器調好，電子槍的能量散佈就無關緊要。
薄樣品是弱相位物體，影像對比由對比傳遞函數 CTF(u) = sin χ(u) 決定，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴，u 是空間頻率。
optionsEn: After Cs correction resolution is limited only by electron wavelength and reaches picometres.
Once the corrector is tuned, the gun's energy spread no longer matters.
A thin specimen is a weak phase object whose image contrast follows the contrast transfer function CTF(u) = sin χ(u) with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴ and u the spatial frequency.

quiz.explanationEn: A thin specimen is a weak phase object whose image contrast follows the contrast transfer function CTF(u) = sin χ(u) with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴ and u the spatial frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Scherzer 點解析度 d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼，Scherzer 離焦 Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ)。300 kV、λ = 1.97 pm：C_s = 0.6 mm 給 d_S = 0.17 nm、Δf_S = −41 nm；C_s = 1.2 mm 給 0.20 nm、−58 nm。最佳物鏡光圈半角 α ≈ (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad。校正器把 C_s 壓到 µm 等級後，光圈由五階像差 C₅ 限制，C₅ = 5 mm 時 α ≈ (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad，可接受的角度大了 2.5 倍，解析度改由資訊極限決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Scherzer point resolution d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼ and Scherzer defocus Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ). At 300 kV with λ = 1.97 pm: C_s = 0.6 mm gives d_S = 0.17 nm and Δf_S = −41 nm; C_s = 1.2 mm gives 0.20 nm and −58 nm. The optimum objective semi-angle is α ≈ (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad. Once a corrector brings C_s to the micrometre level the aperture is limited by fifth-order aberration C₅: with C₅ = 5 mm, α ≈ (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad, 2.5 times the accepted angle, and resolution passes to the information limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在非晶碳膜上拍一系列離焦影像並對每張做傅立葉轉換，Thon 環的半徑序列給出 CTF 的過零點，擬合 χ(u) 可同時解出 Δf 與 C_s；用 Zemlin 離焦傾斜表（在不同束傾角下的 Thon 環）量 C_s、彗差與三重像散；校正後重拍，確認第一過零點移到 0.1 nm 以外且離焦系列中晶格影像不再隨離焦反轉對比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record a defocus series on amorphous carbon and Fourier-transform each image: the Thon-ring radii give the CTF zeros and fitting χ(u) solves Δf and C_s together; measure C_s, coma and threefold astigmatism with a Zemlin tableau of Thon rings at several beam tilts; after correction re-record and confirm the first zero has moved beyond 0.1 nm and lattice images no longer reverse contrast across the defocus series.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Scherzer 點解析度 d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼，Scherzer 離焦 Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ)。300 kV、λ = 1.97 pm：C_s = 0.6 mm 給 d_S = 0.17 nm、Δf_S = −41 nm；C_s = 1.2 mm 給 0.20 nm、−58 nm。最佳物鏡光圈半角 α ≈ (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad。校正器把 C_s 壓到 µm 等級後，光圈由五階像差 C₅ 限制，C₅ = 5 mm 時 α ≈ (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad，可接受的角度大了 2.5 倍，解析度改由資訊極限決定。
knowledge.textEn: Scherzer point resolution d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼ and Scherzer defocus Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ). At 300 kV with λ = 1.97 pm: C_s = 0.6 mm gives d_S = 0.17 nm and Δf_S = −41 nm; C_s = 1.2 mm gives 0.20 nm and −58 nm. The optimum objective semi-angle is α ≈ (4λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10.7 mrad. Once a corrector brings C_s to the micrometre level the aperture is limited by fifth-order aberration C₅: with C₅ = 5 mm, α ≈ (λ/C₅)^⅙ ≈ 27 mrad, 2.5 times the accepted angle, and resolution passes to the information limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction", which statement holds?
options: Scherzer 點解析度 d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼，Scherzer 離焦 Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ)。
軟體顯示的比例尺是絕對的，不需要用晶格校正。

optionsEn: Scherzer point resolution d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼ and Scherzer defocus Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ).
The scale bar shown by the software is absolute and needs no lattice calibration.
Putting the microscope in a basement automatically satisfies vibration and field specifications.

quiz.explanationEn: Scherzer point resolution d_S = 0.66·(C_s·λ³)^¼ and Scherzer defocus Δf_S = −1.2·√(C_s·λ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在非晶碳膜上拍一系列離焦影像並對每張做傅立葉轉換，Thon 環的半徑序列給出 CTF 的過零點，擬合 χ(u) 可同時解出 Δf 與 C_s；用 Zemlin 離焦傾斜表（在不同束傾角下的 Thon 環）量 C_s、彗差與三重像散；校正後重拍，確認第一過零點移到 0.1 nm 以外且離焦系列中晶格影像不再隨離焦反轉對比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record a defocus series on amorphous carbon and Fourier-transform each image: the Thon-ring radii give the CTF zeros and fitting χ(u) solves Δf and C_s together; measure C_s, coma and threefold astigmatism with a Zemlin tableau of Thon rings at several beam tilts; after correction re-record and confirm the first zero has moved beyond 0.1 nm and lattice images no longer reverse contrast across the defocus series. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未校正的顯微鏡在離焦偏離 Scherzer 值 30 nm 時，晶格影像的原子位置與真實位置互換（對比反轉），分析者把亮點當原子柱而把空隙當原子，導出錯誤的介面結構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An uncorrected microscope defocused 30 nm away from the Scherzer value swaps bright and dark lattice positions (contrast reversal); the analyst takes bright spots for atomic columns and gaps for atoms and derives a wrong interface structure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在非晶碳膜上拍一系列離焦影像並對每張做傅立葉轉換，Thon 環的半徑序列給出 CTF 的過零點，擬合 χ(u) 可同時解出 Δf 與 C_s；用 Zemlin 離焦傾斜表（在不同束傾角下的 Thon 環）量 C_s、彗差與三重像散；校正後重拍，確認第一過零點移到 0.1 nm 以外且離焦系列中晶格影像不再隨離焦反轉對比。
knowledge.textEn: Record a defocus series on amorphous carbon and Fourier-transform each image: the Thon-ring radii give the CTF zeros and fitting χ(u) solves Δf and C_s together; measure C_s, coma and threefold astigmatism with a Zemlin tableau of Thon rings at several beam tilts; after correction re-record and confirm the first zero has moved beyond 0.1 nm and lattice images no longer reverse contrast across the defocus series.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在非晶碳膜上拍一系列離焦影像並對每張做傅立葉轉換，Thon 環的半徑序列給出 CTF 的過零點，擬合 χ(u) 可同時解出 Δf 與 C_s。
規格表上的解析度就是日常使用時可達到的解析度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Record a defocus series on amorphous carbon and Fourier-transform each image: the Thon-ring radii give the CTF zeros and fitting χ(u) solves Δf and C_s together.
The resolution on the specification sheet is the resolution achieved in daily use.
quiz.explanation: 在非晶碳膜上拍一系列離焦影像並對每張做傅立葉轉換，Thon 環的半徑序列給出 CTF 的過零點，擬合 χ(u) 可同時解出 Δf 與 C_s；用 Zemlin 離焦傾斜表（在不同束傾角下的 Thon 環）量 C_s、彗差與三重像散；校正後重拍，確認第一過零點移到 0.1 nm 以外且離焦系列中晶格影像不再隨離焦反轉對比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record a defocus series on amorphous carbon and Fourier-transform each image: the Thon-ring radii give the CTF zeros and fitting χ(u) solves Δf and C_s together; measure C_s, coma and threefold astigmatism with a Zemlin tableau of Thon rings at several beam tilts; after correction re-record and confirm the first zero has moved beyond 0.1 nm and lattice images no longer reverse contrast across the defocus series. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未校正的顯微鏡在離焦偏離 Scherzer 值 30 nm 時，晶格影像的原子位置與真實位置互換（對比反轉），分析者把亮點當原子柱而把空隙當原子，導出錯誤的介面結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An uncorrected microscope defocused 30 nm away from the Scherzer value swaps bright and dark lattice positions (contrast reversal); the analyst takes bright spots for atomic columns and gaps for atoms and derives a wrong interface structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：六極或八極 Cs 校正器產生負的球面像差抵銷物鏡的正值，使 C_s 可調到接近零甚至微負，過零點外推到色像差資訊極限，解析度由 0.17 nm 進入 0.1 nm 以下，並消除離域效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A hexapole or octupole Cs corrector produces negative spherical aberration to cancel the objective's positive value, letting C_s be tuned near zero or slightly negative, pushing the first zero out to the chromatic information limit, taking resolution from 0.17 nm to below 0.1 nm and removing delocalisation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Cs 校正後解析度只受電子波長限制，可以達到皮米。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After Cs correction resolution is limited only by electron wavelength and reaches picometres." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未校正的顯微鏡在離焦偏離 Scherzer 值 30 nm 時，晶格影像的原子位置與真實位置互換（對比反轉），分析者把亮點當原子柱而把空隙當原子，導出錯誤的介面結構。
knowledge.textEn: An uncorrected microscope defocused 30 nm away from the Scherzer value swaps bright and dark lattice positions (contrast reversal); the analyst takes bright spots for atomic columns and gaps for atoms and derives a wrong interface structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相位對比傳遞、Scherzer 解析度與 Cs 校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Phase-contrast transfer, Scherzer resolution and Cs correction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要像差校正器調好，電子槍的能量散佈就無關緊要。
未校正的顯微鏡在離焦偏離 Scherzer 值 30 nm 時，晶格影像的原子位置與真實位置互換（對比反轉），分析者把亮點當原子柱而把空隙當原子，導出錯誤的介面結構。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Once the corrector is tuned, the gun's energy spread no longer matters.
An uncorrected microscope defocused 30 nm away from the Scherzer value swaps bright and dark lattice positions (contrast reversal).
quiz.explanation: 未校正的顯微鏡在離焦偏離 Scherzer 值 30 nm 時，晶格影像的原子位置與真實位置互換（對比反轉），分析者把亮點當原子柱而把空隙當原子，導出錯誤的介面結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uncorrected microscope defocused 30 nm away from the Scherzer value swaps bright and dark lattice positions (contrast reversal); the analyst takes bright spots for atomic columns and gaps for atoms and derives a wrong interface structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
